key_insight: Batching parameter-shift evaluations into each quantum-cloud job accelerates quantum neural network training under matched job and shot budgets.
engineering_relevance: Optimizer design should maximize useful learning per queued processor interaction, not merely minimize circuit evaluations.
method: Compare optimizers using equal job counts and shots per job.
Precompute parameter-shift batches to estimate gradients within each job.
Test a structure-aware stencil search that interprets parameter sweeps as sinusoids.
evidence_signal: Simulations with 24–48 parameters required one-fifth to one-half as many jobs as SPSA; three interleaved IBM ibm_fez runs at six and eight qubits matched SPSA’s 50-job final training loss within 4–20 jobs.
watch_item: Hardware evidence is limited to six and eight qubits, and the test-accuracy advantage was not significant at six qubits.
paper_title: Training quantum neural networks one job at a time
